main_text.p: pro quâ pugnatur: quàm quasi fides in-cipiat à nobis; sed excitata extrinsecus Dei dono, ceu causâ & merito? Quare Augustinus, postquam exposuisset, Pelagium ipsum, in Episcopali judicio Palestino, compulsum esse damnare sententiam istam, de initio fidei in nobis; refutatam Scripturâ, Rom.11.v.35,36. Phil.1.v.29.&c.& Cypriano, dicente ex 1. Cor. 4.v.7. in nullo gloriandum; quando nihil nostrum sit: pergit cap.3. se hoc pracipuè testimonio convictum: cùm similiter erraret, putans, fidem non esse donum Dei; sed à nobis, & in nobis, &c. ut prædicato Evangelio assentiremus. Quem meum errorem, inquit, nonnulla opuscula mea satis indicant, ante Episcopatu meum scripta. In quibus est illud, quod commemorastis in literis vestris: ubi est expositio quarundam propositionum ex Epistolâ ad Rom. Denique, cùm mea cuncta opuscula retractarem, &c. cùm ad hunc librum retractandum pervenissem in primo volumine, sic indè locutus sum: Item disputans, quid, inquam, elegerit Deus in nondum-nato, cui dixit servituram esse majorem; & quid in eadem majore nondum-nato similiter repro-

page.notes: The small "»" marks at the right of the lines are typographic line marks, not text, so they are left out. The signature "C 5" at the foot is partly worn: the 5 is doubtful, shown as printed. The left strip is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Spelling such as "pracipuè", "Palastino" and "Episcopatu" is copied as printed. The final word "repro-" runs on to the next page, so the paragraph is not closed.
